# 3 Maccabees Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Alexandrinus) | **Section:** The Elephants Miraculously Restrained

---

**5:1** Now Hermon, having prepared the aforesaid beasts, was preparing to bring them forward at dawn to the hippodrome.

**5:2** But the Lord sent upon the king a sleep that was deep and pleasant, and thus the Lord defeated his lawless purpose and greatly frustrated his stubborn will.

**5:3** The king remained there until late morning, sleeping soundly; and when he did finally wake, having been released from his heavy slumber, he did not remember a thing.

**5:4** He asked the servants who were around him what had caused him to sleep so long, since he had always made it his habit to attend to affairs of state from early morning.

**5:5** When they explained to him what had happened, he ordered that the Jews be brought without delay, and said nothing about the elephants.

**5:6** But when the people at the court — and above all the Friends of the king — heard this, they were amazed that such a heavy sleep had fallen upon the king, and they praised God for delivering the Jews.

**5:7** The Jews, on hearing of the king's change of plans, praised God their guardian and again prayed for his merciful protection, while those who were bolder among them were greatly encouraged.

**5:8** Meanwhile Hermon was astonished at the sudden change and went to inform the king, saying: Most Great King, we are ready to carry out the plan, and we are here to proceed as you instructed.

**5:9** But the king looked up at him with a terrible face and said: If your parents or children were here, I would have prepared them for the wild beasts instead — for those who sought to dishonor me and betray me.

**5:10** But Hermon, having received this unexpected and dangerous rebuke, was greatly distressed and troubled in his expression.

**5:11** After this the Friends gradually turned the king's attention to something else, and in this way they succeeded in diverting his anger.

**5:12** The same heavy and persistent sleep came upon the king again.

**5:13** The Jews escaped complete destruction on that day as well.

**5:14** After the king had come to himself again, his mind still troubled, he said: Why have you disturbed me? I gave you no order concerning these things.

**5:15** But when the Friends, the chief stewards and managers of his affairs, reminded him of it, he flew into a sudden fury and ordered the Jews to be brought to the hippodrome the very next day.

**5:16** Then those who were in charge of the Jews went away in great disorder and confusion, and returning to the hippodrome they were overcome with pity at the plight of the imprisoned Jews.

**5:17** Among them was Hermon the elephant keeper, who was the one responsible for this whole ordeal, and he arranged for the wine to be mixed with unmixed wine and frankincense to intoxicate the five hundred elephants, and he drove them forward as the king had commanded.

**5:18** But a man named Eleazar, notable among the Jewish priests, called to the Lord with a great voice and said:

**5:19** O King, great in power, Most High God, Almighty, who governs all creation with mercy, look upon the descendants of Abraham, upon the children of the sanctified Jacob, upon your sanctified inheritance, O Father, who are unjustly being put to death as foreigners in a foreign land.

**5:20** You scattered Egypt and its Pharaoh with plagues when they arrogantly oppressed our holy fathers, O God.

**5:21** You are the Lord of lords, you who govern all creation; look upon us.

**5:22** Have mercy on us who are in bitter affliction and let your mercy save us from this evil.

**5:23** Hear our prayer and turn aside the malice of those who are acting against us unjustly.

**5:24** Destroy what is done in the power of arrogance; let the Mighty One who saved Abraham from the furnace of the Chaldeans also save us.

**5:25** And as you showed mercy to Daniel in the lions' den, and to the three youths Ananias, Azariah, and Mishael, show mercy to us also.
